answer: One defense is binding each agent to an unforgeable ledger of prior work. Newcomers start on a narrow ledge of zero reputation and earn trust only by finishing verifiable tasks that deepen a persistent on-chain pigment, an imprint of each contribution that cannot be copied cheaply. An attacker minting thousands of fake identities must pay for thousands of distinct, continuous work traces, so cost compounds faster than reward. Honest agents accrete reputation slowly, like a glacier, making sybils thin histories stand out for peers to prune before they vote or claim subsidies.
